title: Classify all shortest words for the rank-two st endpoint
body:
This resolves PR6449's released rank-two internal-coupling question for one exact endpoint. Over any field, every shortest normalized four-call word for `I+([st]-[e])E`, `rank(E)=2`, is exactly one of two families: `sstt` with arbitrary complementary plane pairs P/E-P and Q/E-Q, or `stst` with one complementary pair. The first family permits noncommuting P,Q. No u-labelled call occurs, and arbitrary dirty spectators are restored at the full formal S4 endpoint.

The new contribution is the **complete equality classification inside the active plane**. Minimum four, tight spectator elimination, ordered-pair geometry and rank-one rigidity are inherited and explicitly credited to Richardson1989/Gall, Brian4765 and Petalas6449/4851. Cinna Davis's binary minima are also prior work. `PROOF.md` gives the all-field image/kernel peel argument; finite checks do not supply its universal quantifier. No literature-priority claim is made.

Exact finite evidence: independent full-formal2+2 and faithful regular-action3+1 joins agree on **all1,128 ordered hit words** over F2/F3/F5: 42=36+6,156=144+12,930=900+30. Every projector and all three paid labels are covered, preserving every join collision. The domain covers67,394,592 full candidate words by exact joins; it does not directly iterate every full word. Rational noncommuting fixtures and dirty-spectator regular columns pass. Ten primary controls and four oracle incorrect-word coefficient witnesses address actual failure modes.

Validation passes: strict normal/optimized emissions and defaults; full retained receipts;15-file source-history/byte/mode checks; official export integrity; four read-only Git-free/empty-PATH replays; ten external optimized corruption rejections. Three predecessor proof texts are verbatim and authenticated; no predecessor scientific checker is run. An initial root family-key comparison and two oracle adapter defaults failed on schema names/list-versus-count. All failed captures are preserved; the adapter is fixed, all final runs pass and the scientific receipts are unchanged.

Reproduce with CPython3.12, standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank-two-st-shortest-words
```
